description: Authoritative 5₂=K_2 cyclotomic coefficients C_{5_2,n}(q) from Masbaum's twist-knot formula (masbaum2003), via the derived Kashaev-tail basis bridge C_{K,n}=(-1)^n q^{n(n+1)/2} f̃_{K,n}. Reproduces V_{5_2} at N=2; the self-calibrating heuristic matches exactly. scope-(b).

assertions.name: masbaum_reproduces_jones_5two_at_N2
assertions.source: Masbaum Thm 5.1/Rem 5.2 for K_2 reproduces the standard KnotInfo Jones polynomial V_{5_2}(t) at N=2 under t=q⁻¹ — validates the cyclotomic coefficients against an independent authoritative value (masbaum2003, DOI 10.2140/agt.2003.3.537)

assertions.name: bridge_gives_C_n_one_for_fourone
assertions.source: the derived basis bridge C_{K,n}=(-1)^n q^{n(n+1)/2}·f̃_{K,n} maps Masbaum's f̃_{4_1,n}=(-1)^n q^{-n(n+1)/2} to C_n=1, matching Kashaev's figure-eight tail — the bridge is exact

assertions.name: selfcalibrating_shortcut_matches_masbaum
assertions.source: the earlier self-calibrating (V_{5_2}-1)/(V_{4_1}-1) heuristic gave C_{5_2,1}=-(t⁻²+t⁻⁴); at t=q⁻¹ this equals the authoritative Masbaum-derived C_{5_2,1}(q)=-(q⁴+q²) EXACTLY — the flagged 'colored-jones gate' heuristic is validated, not erroneous

assertions.name: cyclotomic_coeff_bar_asymmetric
assertions.source: C_{5_2,n}(q) ≠ C_{5_2,n}(q⁻¹) for n≥1 — 5₂ is chiral, so its cyclotomic coefficients supply a nonzero bar-odd Habiro datum (the odd-locus, Lean HabiroCyclotomicOddLocus)

result.verdict: VALIDATED + AUTHORITATIVE. Masbaum's twist-knot formula (masbaum2003) gives the exact 5₂ = K_2 cyclotomic coefficients; they reproduce the standard Jones polynomial V_{5_2} at N=2. The derived basis bridge C_{K,n}=(-1)^n q^{n(n+1)/2}·f̃_{K,n} is exact (C_n=1 on 4₁). The earlier self-calibrating (V_{5_2}-1)/(V_{4_1}-1) heuristic — flagged by the owner as a possibly-erroneous probe — MATCHES the authoritative C_{5_2,1}(q)=-(q⁴+q²) exactly, so it stands. Authoritative higher coefficients: C_{5_2,2}=q¹¹+q⁸+q⁷+q⁵, C_{5_2,3}=-(q²¹+q¹⁷+q¹⁶+q¹⁵+q¹³+q¹²+q¹¹+q⁹). All bar-asymmetric — the 5₂ bar-odd Habiro datum for the Q_β odd channel. scope-(b): exact Laurent-polynomial identities from a cited published formula. NO fit; NO c_k wired.

context.axis: b3ix odd-locus — authoritative 5₂ coefficient (continuation of #3970/#3993; answers 'be critical' colored-jones gate)
